bitcoin.name: Bitcoin
bitcoin.role: Digital gold. Scarce store of value with fixed 21M supply. Institutional anchor asset.

mvrv_zscore_sell.description: MVRV Z-Score above 7 = historically marks cycle tops

sell_triggers: MVRV Z-Score enters red zone (>7)
ETF net outflows exceed $1B over 5 consecutive days
Price breaks below realized price (~$54K) with rising exchange inflows
Bitcoin dominance peaks above 65% then sharply reverses
Fed pivots to aggressive rate hikes
buy_signals: Price reclaims STH cost basis from below
ETF inflows sustain >$500M/day for a week
bitcoin.cycle_notes: April 2024 halving. Tops typically 12-18 months post-halving. Next halving ~April 2028.

ethereum.name: Ethereum
ethereum.role: DeFi settlement layer. Staking yield ~3-4%. Network upgrades Glamsterdam/Hegota in 2026.
sell_triggers: TVL declines 30%+ over 30 days
Major network upgrade fails or delayed
ETH/BTC ratio breaks below 0.02
Active addresses trend down 3 months
Solana captures majority of stablecoin settlement
buy_signals: ETH ETF inflows accelerate past BTC
ethereum.cycle_notes: Typically lags BTC early, outperforms late. Currently 59% below ATH vs BTC 42%.

solana.name: Solana
solana.role: High-performance app platform. 65K+ TPS, sub-second finality, near-zero fees. Your current holding ($16.3K).
sell_triggers: Major network outage (9 in 2022 — recurrence reprices risk)
Large DeFi exploit >$100M on Solana protocols
ETF approval denied or delayed past 2026
Daily active addresses fall below 1M consistently
buy_signals: Stablecoin volume on Solana outpaces Ethereum
solana.cycle_notes: Down 68% from Jan 2026 highs. SEC commodity classification March 2026. 7+ ETF filings. Highest beta of the three majors.

chainlink.name: Chainlink
chainlink.role: Decentralized oracle network. CCIP for cross-chain interop. ~75% oracle market share.
sell_triggers: Major oracle competitor gains >20% share
Critical oracle failure causes large DeFi loss
CCIP adoption stalls
Token unlock creates sustained sell pressure
buy_signals: Major bank integrates CCIP for tokenized assets

ripple.name: XRP
ripple.role: Cross-border payment settlement. 300+ financial institutions. Defensive utility crypto.
sell_triggers: New regulatory action or SEC reversal
Major bank exits RippleNet
SWIFT launches competitive instant settlement
XRP ETF denied

avalanche-2.name: Avalanche
avalanche-2.role: Enterprise blockchain. Subnet architecture. JPMorgan/Deloitte/AWS partnerships.
sell_triggers: Major enterprise partner exits
Subnet adoption stalls 2+ quarters
TVL drops below $1B
Competing L1 captures enterprise market
